authority: SpryLabs HPC source repo is source-first. Root sprawl is legacy compatibility only, not the target architecture.
current_artifact_scope: Tree architecture contract plus validator and release alignment. This artifact freezes the existing root output surface, prevents new root sprawl, and treats coverage/ as generated reporting output excluded from baseline artifacts.

target_tree.root: Repo identity, package/runtime entry files, Cloudflare static control files, and transitional route shims only.
target_tree.config: Contracts, manifests, validation policy, and non-secret runtime configuration.
target_tree.content: Human-authored and structured content source records.
target_tree.data: Registries, workflow state, signals, citation intelligence, and generated metadata that is source-controlled by policy.
target_tree.scripts: Build, render, workflow, repair, release, and validation tooling.
target_tree.docs: Architecture records, runbooks, and operator handoff documentation.
target_tree.functions: Cloudflare Functions and server boundary code.
target_tree.tests: Automated tests and route proof fixtures.

legacy_root_html.rule: No new root HTML files. Full migration to generated output/source records must happen in a dedicated URL-parity phase.

legacy_root_json.rule: No new root JSON files. Existing root authority JSON remains only while hardcoded validators and workflows still read root paths.

legacy_root_directories.rule: Root route directory count and name hash are diagnostic only during local updater validation because real repos include .git and may preserve local runtime folders. Hard blocking is reserved for explicitly prohibited packageable source roots; generated reporting output such as coverage/ is ignored locally and excluded from baseline ZIPs.

programmatic_page_policy.rule: Future page growth should be represented as structured source records plus renderers. Public HTML output may exist, but it must not make the repo root the authoring surface.

next_phase: Migrate legacy root pages to generated output/source records in controlled batches with public route parity proof.
